column1: # Rule overrides for the API pass of gate.yml's zap job (the Functions host from
# start-local-stack, SKIP_AUTH, operations from .zap/openapi.yaml). Format as in rules-frontend.tsv.
# Header findings stay WARN on purpose: unlike the static frontend, the API can send headers (#558, #560).
# What a handler must never do, whatever the input.

column3: # Application Error Disclosure -- a stack trace or runtime error text in a response body
# Cross-Domain Misconfiguration -- a permissive CORS response (#558)
# Cookie No HttpOnly Flag -- the API sets no cookies; one appearing is a regression
